steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A change needs its effect on scope, cost and date, and an approver.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Change with no approver
findings.fix: Name the approver before the change

findings.title: No effect on date stated
findings.fix: State the effect on the date

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] pmchg-33.md:12  Change with no approver.
       Fix: Name the approver before the change.
[medium] pmchg-32.md:19  No effect on cost stated.
       Fix: State the effect on cost.
[low] pmchg-35.md:26  No effect on date stated.
       Fix: State the effect on the date.
Not checked: Whether the change is needed.
pros: Checks a change with no effect stated on one of scope, cost or date, and a change with no approver.
cons: Not checked: Whether the change is needed.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-change-request skill on the records for this review.
